title: config tests: Box::leak for env var keys unnecessary
description: In config.rs, take_vars() uses Box::leak to produce &'static str keys, with a comment claiming 'leak is fine in test code.' The leak is entirely avoidable: storing Vec<(String, Option<String>)> with owned keys eliminates it. The current approach works but the leak is pointless and the SAFETY comment is misleading — this isn't an unsafe contract, it's a workaround for a lifetime that could be expressed without unsafe at all.
